bosonic spinor current tag excluded in this inventory
two spinor source fields form neutral tag
explicit disorder primitive removes this tag obstruction
neutral source insertions preserve tags
adjoint has the same Z2 tags
ten Clifford generators square to identity
all ten Clifford generators anticommute
central spin rotation acts as -I on spinors
same central element conjugates Clifford vector trivially
original v252 full 96 carrier
central spin action commutes with full v252 D
central spin action commutes with antilinear J
central spin action is not finite chirality gamma_F

marked D5 spinor and conjugate each carry 64 roots
D8 even roots plus Cartan give 120
explicit invariant state and charge-one operator
charged one-point zero but neutral two-point positive
output.algebraic_argument: The commuting parity and central involutions have product Pz². Every listed primitive is fixed by Pz², so all sums, products and adjoints of them are fixed; the fixed algebra is norm closed for a continuous symmetry action. A target of tag (0,1) changes sign and cannot be a nonzero element of that algebra. Equivariant derivations and neutral insertions preserve the conclusion when defined on that algebra.
output.ward_scope: Invariant state and nontrivial character force a charged one-point to zero; neutral correlators need not vanish. The finite matrix example illustrates this identity and is not the physical TFPT state.
output.source_scope: Given primitive Grassmann Spin10 spinors and tensorial bosons, plus equivariant operations. A disorder/sector primitive may change this inventory. E8 current is bosonic; 16 internal spinor states are not 16 Majorana generators. The Spin action z²=-I96 is supplied on the v252 carrier, and commutation with D and J is checked; v252 alone does not derive that representation. z² on H_F is distinct from gamma_F and field parity.
not_proved: P1 source has only this inventory
all possible disorder sectors are absent
physical 3+1D matter, E8 current source or global P1 no-go
